title: Capacity requests workboard — Q4 intake
body:
Context: This is a lightweight intake + triage board capturing GPU capacity requests across teams for Q4/Q1 planning. The goal is to centralize asks, surface blocking dates, and record approvals and fallback plans. This is intentionally informal — use for draft requests and handoffs to allocations team.

Columns (this sheet): RequestID | Team | Project | GPUs (type) | Region preferred | Start date | End date | Peak concurrent pods | Priority (P0/P1/P2) | Business justification | Status | Approver | Notes / follow-ups

Rows (current snapshot):
REQ-652 | Search Infrastructure | Rerank latency tuning | 4 x A100-80GB | us-west1 | 2025-12-08 | 2026-01-15 | 2 | P0 | Critical perf regression in hybrid rerank that blocks GA; customer pilot Dec. | pending-approval | Jen K. (eng-sre) | Need infra cost estimate; request can tolerate 30% lower memory if q8 compatible. Jira: INFRA-2143.

REQ-671 | Research (Applied ML) | LoRA exploration for LLaMA-2 variants | 8 x H100-80GB | europe-west3 preferred, fallback us-central1 | 2025-12-20 | 2026-02-28 | 8 | P1 | Experimentation for potential model onboarding; non-urgent but dataset locked by Jan. | approved | Priya S. | Approved with shared-burst clause. Ask SEs to consolidate jobs to single availability window.

REQ-689 | Platform (Dedicated) | Dedicated fleet stress tests | 16 x A100-40GB | us-east1 | 2026-01-10 | 2026-01-20 | 16 | P1 | Validate autoscaling policies and billing traces for customers. | scheduled | Liam O. | Blocked on network VLAN from private-deployments; ticket raised.

REQ-704 | Console & Rollouts | Canary rollout metrics collection | 2 x T4 | us-west1 | 2026-01-05 | 2026-01-07 | 1 | P2 | Short smoke test for new trace pipeline. | completed | Noah M. | Results uploaded to GH PR #487.

REQ-711 | Solutions Eng | Onsite customer demo (EMEA) | 4 x A10G | europe-west3 | 2025-12-15 | 2025-12-16 | 2 | P0 | Sales-critical demo for enterprise prospect; must be isolated. | in_review | Maya R. | Needs Private network config + HSM test plan.

Triage notes and rules of thumb:
- Priority: P0 = customer-facing or blocker for GA; P1 = important but flexible; P2 = low-impact experiments.
- Approvals: P0 requires signoff from eng-infrastructure lead + product owner; P1 can be approved by infra PM or infra lead; P2 auto-granted if capacity available.
- Allocation strategy: try to colocate requests by region and GPU class to reduce fragmentation. If conflicting P0s exist for same window, escalate to head of infra for tradeoff.
- Fallbacks: indicate fallback region and fallback GPU type (e.g., H100 -> A100-80 if model quantization permits).

Capacity constraints (short summary):
- us-west1: high utilization Dec 8–Jan 10 due to ongoing experiments (estimated 82% baseline).
- europe-west3: medium utilization with scheduled reserved capacity Dec 15–Jan 31 (approx 60%).
- us-east1: low utilization but network config change planned Jan 3–9 (limits burst until resolved).

Open questions and blockers:
- Can Research jobs be consolidated into 2-week windows to enable shared bursts? (Ask: Priya, Research)
- Network VLAN for dedicated tests still pending — INFRA-2199 (owner: Liam).
- HSM endpoints for onsite demos need cert rotation window; coordinate with security (ticket SEC-912).

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Maya R.: finalize P0 approval checklist and post to /infra/allocations by 2025-11-20.
- Liam O.: unblock VLAN ticket or provide ETA by 2025-11-18.
- Priya S.: provide consolidated experiment schedule (preferred start windows) by 2025-12-01.
- Noah M.: attach perf trace artifacts for REQ-704 to GH PR #487 and link here.

Notes for capacity planning meeting (weekly on Mon 10:00 PT):
- Bring hotlist P0s (requests starting within 14 days).
- Confirm fallback readiness for any request that cannot be scheduled in preferred region.
- Update utilization heatmap (infra/capacity-dashboard) before the meeting.

Quick history of edits: initial draft 2025-11-12 (Maya); added research row 2025-11-26 (Priya); marked REQ-704 completed 2026-01-08 (Noah); last reviewed 2026-02-18 (Liam).

References and links:
- Capacity dashboard (internal): /confluence/infra/capacity-dashboard (perf snapshots)
- Jira: INFRA-2143, INFRA-2199
- Slack thread: #infra-capacity (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C0INFRA123)

How to use this doc: copy rows into the canonical allocations spreadsheet when request moves from "pending-approval" to "scheduled". Keep notes compact — large attachments should go to the linked GH/Jira artifacts.

Status legend: pending-approval | approved | scheduled | completed | cancelled | in_review

Bottom-line: treat this as the working board for intake; formal reservation happens in dedicated-capacity contracts board once approved.
